utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, it’s still on today. I’m coming by later this afternoon, and I’ll check what’s still left when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. I’ll bring the remaining supplies and see you later.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll drop off the list soon so we can get everything lined up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll bring it by soon so we can get everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by later and find out what they still need, then I’ll let you know the timing and what’s being hauled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll stop by later, check what they still need, and let you know the timing and what’s being hauled.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can check the sign-up sheet next. After that, I can help with the tables if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — please check the sign-up sheet first, and if you’re still free after that, the tables would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll check the sign-up sheet first, then help with the tables if I’m still free.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for any repair details and start checking with a few neighbors in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey — that’s really helpful. I’ll pass along any repair details as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, Rosa — I’ll be ready when the repair details come in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll start with the tool boxes by the garage and let you know if anything seems short. Sorry again if I’m a bit scattered — I’ll keep an eye out.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — if you spot anything missing, just tell me and I’ll keep the boxes ready by the garage.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do — I’m heading over there now and I’ll tell you right away if I find anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m checking the latest on the repair drive now, and I’ll get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Bo — I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and have the list ready when you do.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll be back with the latest soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll start with the tools and help sort the donations. I’ll also mention the furniture and bike repairs while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be a huge help, thanks — the furniture and bike repairs are exactly the ones we still need to match up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll keep an eye out for anyone who can help with those matches while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll sort the repair list and check who still needs to be contacted, then I’ll let you know so you can jump in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I think Dane was asking about the missing supplies too. If you’ve got the list sorted, just let me know who still needs a nudge.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on it — I’ll sort the list, check who needs a nudge, and flag the missing supplies for Dane too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—let’s tackle the faucet first, then the porch step, and finish with the lamps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll keep it in that order and check in after the faucet is done.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect — that keeps it orderly. I’ll be ready when you check in after the faucet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got it noted at the community hall on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Opal — I’ll spread the word about the community hall on Maple Street right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Glad to help, Quinn—hopefully everyone finds the community hall on Maple Street easily.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can grab the missing supplies and help with the faucet first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds right to me. Grab the supplies, then we’ll start with the faucet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll grab the missing supplies and head to the faucet now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort donations and watch the sign-in table. See you Sunday at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Sam — that’s a huge help. I’ll bring the donation labels and be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center and keep everything organized until you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that would help. If you can share the timing and what’s being hauled, I can figure out the space we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by later and ask what they still need, then I’ll let you know the timing and what’s being hauled.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that sounds good. I’ll wait for your update so I can plan the space properly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late afternoon works well for school pickup—4 to 6 sounds good. I’ll help coordinate around that window.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great—4 to 6 it is. I’ll line up the first repair and bring whatever tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll keep things centered around pickup and drop-off, and I’ll let folks know the 4 to 6 window.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I’m still a bit scattered, but I can help. Just tell me the first location and what needs going there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — what’s the first location, and I’ll note where it goes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure—just give me the first spot, and I’ll keep up as best I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — once we lock in the date and time, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — please let me know as soon as the date and time are set, and I’ll plan for those small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Hana — I’ll let you know as soon as the date and time are set, and I’ll bring the tools for those small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, thanks — I’m still just hearing bits and pieces, so I’ll wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll check what they still need and let you know when to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’ll wait for your update and keep an ear out for the latest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — can you confirm the exact time on Saturday and which repairs we should prioritize?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking the exact time, but I’ll get it to you as soon as I can. For priority, let’s focus on the most urgent repairs and any tools we’ll need first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — please send the exact time when you have it, and I’ll help focus on the most urgent repairs and tools first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, still on for today — I’m just checking the list now so we can grab whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming, we’re still meeting today for it, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, still on — I’m just checking what’s left so we can grab the last few things.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ve got everything organized and ready for you when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll be there a bit later and we can sort it out together.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep it all set and wait for you here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rey—thanks! Come by the community center at 2, and I’ll put you on tools and greeting duty.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be there Sunday at the community center at 2.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Rey—really appreciate it. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center at 2!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort screws and nails into small boxes, quietly. That would help me stay useful without taking on too much.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — can you take a small box of screws and one of nails, then let me know when they’re sorted?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can do that quietly and let you know when they’re sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ve got the Sunday community center update noted. Send your list when you’re ready, and I’ll help keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rosa — I’ll send the list over as soon as it’s ready, and I’m glad to help keep things organized too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I appreciate that. I’ll watch for your list and keep the Sunday community center plans moving along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What date and time should I put down for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — let’s put it down for Saturday at 10 a.m., if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday at 10 a.m. works for me.
